newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India, Taiwan GDRs off with world mkts.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India, Taiwan GDRs off with world mkts.

text.p: Global depositary receipts traded in London were marked down in line with weaker world markets in thin trade on Monday, dealers said.
"East Indian Hotels and ICICI saw some demand but other than that there was very little going on," said one Indian GDR dealer.
EIH Ltd dipped six cents to $13.50/14.50, while ICICI was off 18 at $18.25/19.25. Interest in Indian stocks was limited by the holiday on the Bombay and Delhi bourses.
The HSBC James Capel India GDR index lost 1.77 points, or 2.09 percent, to 82.91, a premium of 16.43 percent to the local market.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index, which measures changes from midday to midday, was down 1.94 points at 93.98.
Taiwan business was also reduced by lack of a lead from the home market. The Taiwan market was closed on Monday because of a typhoon.
The Capel Taiwan index was down 4.75 points, or 3.45 percent, at 132.88 -- representing a discount of 4.93 percent.
The Capel Korea index finished down 2.38 points, or 3.12 percent, at 74.12, a premium of 36.89 percent.
